title: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signs SB 315, a bill requiring annual third-party safety audits of leading AI companies; OpenAI and Anthropic backed the bill (Adam Harrington/CBS News)
summary: Adam Harrington / CBS News: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker signs SB 315, a bill requiring annual third-party safety audits of leading AI companies; OpenAI and Anthropic backed the bill — Add CBS News on Google — Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker on Monday signed legislation aimed at holding artificial intelligence companies accountable.
